title: Mittag-Leffler submodule in a universally exact sequence
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $0\to M_1\to M_2\to M_3\to0$ be a universally exact short exact sequence of $R$-modules, meaning that tensoring this sequence over $R$ with every $R$-module remains exact. If $M_2$ is a Mittag-Leffler $R$-module [def-trf-mittag-leffler-module], then $M_1$ is a Mittag-Leffler $R$-module.

mathlib_searches.query: a universally exact short exact sequence with Mittag Leffler middle module has Mittag Leffler submodule
mathlib_searches.results: Category/module exactness and AdicCompletion.map_exact hits; no pure-submodule Mittag-Leffler theorem.
LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ and generic exactness declarations; no ML inheritance theorem.
